questions.question: When should these console.warn calls actually log?

options.label: Only in production
options.description: Gate on !__DEV__: warnings are hidden while developing (clean console now) and only emitted in production builds. This matches what you literally asked.

options.label: Only in development
options.description: Gate on __DEV__: warnings show while developing/debugging and are stripped from production builds. This is the conventional RN pattern — useful if your goal is just to keep them out of shipped apps.

answers.When should these console.warn calls act: only development, só uma dúvida, assim como, por exemplo, o vitE tem algumas variáveis de env que a gente pode ter acesso no nAvagador como VITE_* - Como foi isso que funciona no mobile?
